criterion: Create a signed/hashable challenger registry and promote only through future authorized evidence gates; training performance alone cannot promote a model.
test_result: 16 challenger-registry and learned-model tests passed; Ruff and targeted mypy passed. Tests cover hash-chain integrity, signatures, challenger-only training registration, promotion evidence gates, human approval scope, and duplicate refusal.
evidence_scope: Synthetic registry and promotion-gate tests; no real prospective cohort or promoted model.
operational_limits: Signing uses an owner-supplied HMAC key and is not independent third-party attestation.
An owner must protect signing keys and supply verified prospective evidence before promotion.
Training jobs can register challengers only and cannot promote them.
